items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/experiments/macrocell_scaling.md` plus the macrocell library artifact. The report must include explicit controls for interface randomization, `X`-label shuffling, and held-out aspect ratios, and must explain why the result is not just algorithmic self-assembly, AlphaEvolve-style search, or a malformed-watchlist overlap.

The atlas must be verifier-checkable and must separate bounded-slope failure from decoder leakage and geometry-only effects.

items.description: Expose an arithmetic-sensitivity phase transition that separates genuine label use from geometry memorization
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/experiments/arithmetic_sensitivity_phase_transition.md`. Acceptance requires an exact sweep over at least three rational-complexity regimes and at least two held-out legal alphabets showing where `X`-label shuffling destroys performance, where it does not, and how that boundary changes after proof-state canonicalization or macrocell typing; ties the observed boundary back to trace-normal-form motifs or the new monotone obstruction; and shows that a geometry-only or motif-only control family fails to reproduce the same phase transition. This item only passes if it yields a counterintuitive collapse boundary or survival zone not already implied by the current literature notes.

items.description: Demonstrate a threshold-saturated exact-certificate ladder whose coupled forcing wave beats uncoupled witness growth
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/experiments/spatial_coupling_threshold.md` plus an exact-verified micro-gadget bank. Acceptance requires constructing at least one family of exact-valid seed gadgets, coupling them across 6-10 slabs with at least two coupling widths, and showing a clear exact score-density or hit-rate advantage over uncoupled repetition, Random Local Search, and Whole-Witness Mutation under matched exact-decode budgets and matched `m(G)+|R|` accounting. The result must identify a critical coupling or boundary-seed regime, must collapse under template randomization or `X`-label shuffling, must be stress-tested on at least one held-out aspect ratio and one held-out legal `X`, and must explicitly explain why the phenomenon is not generic LDPC-style spatial coupling, Cowen-Breen-style adjacent pattern optimization, or a malformed-watchlist false overlap.
